title: 2BHK flat, Bengaluru (BBMP area), 11-month agreement

governing_law.summary: The Karnataka Rent Act, 1999 does not apply to this flat: the rent is above the Part A ceiling and the building is less than 15 years old. The lease is governed by the agreement itself, read with the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 and the Indian Contract Act, 1872.

steps: Read the agreement and split it into clauses (read_agreement, PII redacted first).
Decide which law governs: run the Karnataka Rent Act applicability test (check_jurisdiction).
Look up every section I intend to rely on (lookup_section).
Price each unfair clause in rupees (compute_money).
Send every legal claim through the verifier before it reaches the tenant.
Draft a polite counter-proposal for the landlord and wait for the tenant's approval.

trace.summary: 12 clauses over 4 pages; 3 personal identifiers redacted before any model call.

trace.question: In which year was the building constructed (or last substantially renovated)?
trace.why: Section 2(3)(f) of the Karnataka Rent Act exempts a building for 15 years after construction. I cannot decide which law governs without it.

trace.summary: Rent Act does not apply: s.2(3)(e) rent ceiling and s.2(3)(f) 15-year exemption.

reasons.text: Rent Rs 25,000 exceeds the Rs 3,500 ceiling for a First Schedule Part A area.
Built in 2019: within 15 years of construction.

trace.summary: MTA-11 found, but applies_in_karnataka is false: Karnataka has not adopted the Model Tenancy Act.
Clause 6 deposit forfeiture: Rs 2,50,000 at risk.
Clause 5 lock-in: 6 months x Rs 25,000 = Rs 1,50,000.
Clause 4 escalation 15%: (15 - 10)% of Rs 3,00,000 annual rent = Rs 15,000.

trace.claim: The Karnataka Rent Act does not apply because the rent is above Rs 3,500 a month in a Part A area.
trace.reason: Section exists in law/karnataka.json and applies in Karnataka.

trace.claim: A building constructed in 2019 is within the 15-year exemption.
trace.reason: Section exists in law/karnataka.json and applies in Karnataka.

trace.claim: Forfeiting the whole deposit on early exit is a penalty; the landlord can recover only reasonable compensation for actual loss.
trace.reason: Section exists in law/karnataka.json and applies in Karnataka.

trace.claim: At the end of the lease the tenant must return the flat in the condition received, subject to reasonable wear and tear.
trace.reason: Section exists in law/karnataka.json and applies in Karnataka.

trace.claim: Karnataka law caps the security deposit at two months' rent.
trace.reason: Wrong law: MTA-11 is from the Model Tenancy Act, 2021, which Karnataka has not adopted (applies_in_karnataka: false). The Karnataka Rent Act has no deposit cap. Claim removed from the draft.

trace.claim: The landlord must refund the deposit within 30 days of the tenant vacating.
trace.reason: Legal claim with no section id. No source supports a statutory 30-day deadline; claim removed from the draft.

trace.claim: A 15% yearly increase is above Dhara's 10% fairness threshold.
trace.reason: Not a legal claim: the 10% figure is a product threshold, not a legal limit. Shown with that label.

trace.summary: Counter-proposal drafted in English and Kannada (tone: request), using only cited claims.

findings.clause_text: If the Tenant vacates the premises before the expiry of the lock-in period, the entire security deposit of Rs 2,50,000 shall stand forfeited to the Owner.
findings.issue: The whole deposit is forfeited on early exit, whatever the landlord's actual loss. Excessive forfeiture is a penalty; only reasonable compensation is recoverable.
findings.ask: Replace forfeiture with deduction of actual, itemised loss.

findings.clause_text: The agreement carries a lock-in of six (6) months. If the Tenant leaves within the lock-in, the Tenant shall pay rent for the balance of the lock-in period.
findings.issue: Leaving in month one costs up to six months' rent, on top of the deposit forfeiture in Clause 6.
findings.ask: Cap the early-exit payment at one month's rent, or waive it if a replacement tenant is found.

findings.clause_text: At the time of vacating, a sum of Rs 25,000 shall be deducted from the deposit towards painting charges, irrespective of the condition of the premises.
findings.issue: A fixed painting charge applies even if the walls are in the condition received. The tenant answers only for damage beyond reasonable wear and tear.
findings.ask: Charge painting only for damage beyond reasonable wear and tear, judged against the dated move-in checklist.

findings.clause_text: The monthly rent shall stand enhanced by fifteen percent (15%) on every renewal.
findings.issue: A 15% increase at each renewal is above Dhara's 10% fairness threshold.
findings.ask: Revise the increase to 10% at renewal.
findings.money_note: (15 - 10)% of Rs 3,00,000 annual rent. The 10% is a product threshold, not a legal limit.

text.en:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for sharing the draft rental agreement for the flat. Before I sign, I request the following changes:

1. Clause 6 (deposit forfeiture): please replace forfeiture of the full deposit with deduction of actual, itemised loss. Under Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, only reasonable compensation is recoverable.

2. Clause 5 (lock-in): please cap the early-exit payment at one month's rent, or waive it if I find a replacement tenant.

3. Clause 8 (painting): please charge painting only for damage beyond reasonable wear and tear, against the dated move-in checklist we both sign (Transfer of Property Act, 1882, Section 108).

4. Clause 4 (rent increase): please revise the increase at renewal from 15% to 10%.

I am happy to sign once these changes are made.

Regards,
[Tenant]
text.kn:
ಮಾನ್ಯರೇ,

ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಟ್‌ನ ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಕರಡನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಈ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೋರುತ್ತೇನೆ:

1. ಷರತ್ತು 6 (ಠೇವಣಿ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು): ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಠೇವಣಿ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲಿನ ಬದಲು, ನಿಜವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ವಿವರವಾದ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಕಡಿತಗೊಳಿಸಿ. ಭಾರತೀಯ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 1872ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 74ರ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಸಮಂಜಸ ಪರಿಹಾರವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ವಸೂಲಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

2. ಷರತ್ತು 5 (ಲಾಕ್-ಇನ್): ಬೇಗ ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಪಾವತಿಯನ್ನು ಒಂದು ತಿಂಗಳ ಬಾಡಿಗೆಗೆ ಮಿತಿಗೊಳಿಸಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಬದಲಿ ಬಾಡಿಗೆದಾರರನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿದರೆ ಮನ್ನಾ ಮಾಡಿ.

3. ಷರತ್ತು 8 (ಬಣ್ಣ): ಸಮಂಜಸ ಸವಕಳಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಹಾನಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ, ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ, ಬಣ್ಣದ ವೆಚ್ಚ ವಿಧಿಸಿ (ಆಸ್ತಿ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ, 1882, ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 108).

4. ಷರತ್ತು 4 (ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ): ನವೀಕರಣದ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳವನ್ನು 15% ರಿಂದ 10% ಕ್ಕೆ ಇಳಿಸಿ.

ಈ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ ಒಪ್ಪಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ.

ವಂದನೆಗಳು,
[ಬಾಡಿಗೆದಾರ]

KRA-2(3)(f).title: Act does not apply for 15 years after construction or substantial renovation
